title: gendered language in telephone conversations: a corpus-based study of lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic variation
core_idea: To investigate gender-related variation in spoken American English by analyzing a large corpus of spontaneous telephone conversations (the Switchboard Dialogue Act Corpus) using a variationist, corpus-based quantitative methodology to examine lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic dimensions.
tldr: A corpus-based, variationist study that aims to identify how gender correlates with lexical, grammatical, and pragmatic patterns in spontaneous telephone speech using the Switchboard Dialogue Act Corpus.
